name: ilovemusic-desktop
description: ILoveMusic - SoundCloud & Spotify Music Downloader and Player with BPM Detection (Premium Quality - 320kbps)
author: CactusDomain

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @ilovemusic/engine && concurrently "npm run dev --prefix renderer" "electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @ilovemusic/engine && npm run build --prefix renderer && electron-builder
scripts.build:mac: npm run build --workspace @ilovemusic/engine && npm run build --prefix renderer && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:win: npm run build --workspace @ilovemusic/engine && npm run build --prefix renderer && electron-builder --win
scripts.build:linux: npm run build --workspace @ilovemusic/engine && npm run build --prefix renderer && electron-builder --linux
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @ilovemusic/engine && npm run test --workspace @ilovemusic/api
